Ravi Kapoor: Quick flag — saw ~80 leads in HS "New" for >9m. Enrichment backlog again?
Ellen Brooks: Yep, queueing spike. Our rule waits on `enriched_company=true` before RR.
Ravi Kapoor: Proposal: 9-minute heartbeat -> set owner = Queue:Inbound-Auto and set property `auto_handoff=v3`. Add internal note.
Carla Mendes: On SF side map Queue to an SF Queue and add daily alert if size > 30. Reconcile when enrichment populates `assigned_rep_id` (enrichment wins if rep_active=true).
ops-bot: deploy-bot: routing patch branch `hotfix/hs-autohandoff-9m` queued.
Ellen Brooks: I'll push the HS workflow draft and tag RevOps for dashboards.
Ravi Kapoor: Great — let's review tomorrow 11:00am PT.
